import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = (int) 1e9 + 7;
    static final int MOD2 = 1007681537;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final long LINF = (long) 1e18;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;

    static int addmod(int a, int b, int p) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= p) a -= p;
        return a;
    }

    static int submod(int a, int b, int p) {
        a -= b;
        if (a < 0) a += p;
        return a;
    }

    static int mult(int a, int b, int p) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % p);
    }

    static int fpow(int n, int k, int p) {
        int r = 1;
        while (k > 0) {
            if ((k & 1) == 1) r = mult(r, n, p);
            n = mult(n, n, p);
            k >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static int inv(int a, int p) {
        return fpow(a, p - 2, p);
    }

    static int gcd(int a, int b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            int r = a % b;
            a = b;
            b = r;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static int lcm(int a, int b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    static int bit(int n, int i) {
        return (n >> i) & 1;
    }

    static int bitcount(int n) {
        return Integer.bitCount(n);
    }

    static int lg(int n) {
        return 31 - Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros(n);
    }

    static void transform(int[] a, int n, int p, int invert) {
        int k = lg(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            for (int msk = 0; msk < n; msk++) {
                if (bit(msk, i) == 1) {
                    int pmsk = msk ^ (1 << i);
                    if (invert == 0) {
                        a[msk] = addmod(a[msk], a[pmsk], p);
                    } else {
                        a[msk] = submod(a[msk], a[pmsk], p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) {
            return a.clone();
        } else if ((k & 1) == 1) {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = addmod(res[i + j], mult(r[i], a[j], p), p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] r = pow_convol(a, k >> 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n - i; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = addmod(res[i + j], mult(r[i], r[j], p), p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subset_pow_convol(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        while (n != (n & -n)) n += n & -n;
        int logn = lg(n);
        int[][] fa = new int[logn][n];
        int[][] fc = new int[logn][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (bitcount(j) == i) {
                    fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
                } else {
                    fa[i][j] = 0;
                }
                fc[i][j] = 0;
            }
            transform(fa[i], n, p, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int[] va = new int[logn];
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                va[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            va = pow_convol(va, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < logn; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = va[j];
            }
        }
        int[] res = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < logn; i++) {
            transform(fc[i], n, p, 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (bitcount(j) == i) {
                    res[j] = fc[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static void solve(Scanner sc) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int nn = 0;
        int[] f = new int[MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                    if (bit(n, j) == 1) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= bit(i, j);
                    }
                }
                f[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(fpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }
        int[] fac = new int[MAXN];
        int[] ifac = new int[MAXN];
        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = mult(fac[i - 1], i, p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            ifac[i] = inv(fac[i], p);
        }
        int[] a = new int[nn + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; i++) {
            a[i] = ifac[f[i]];
        }
        int res = fpow(k, n, p);
        a = subset_pow_convol(a, k, p);
        res = submod(res, mult(a[nn], fac[n], p), p);
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        solve(sc);
        sc.close();
    }
}
